changelog: Fix: challenges.starting_balance for the Bitfunded Altcoin challenge (id 6) was 9,274.00 — the account's equity on 2026-08-10 when the record was created, not the real 10,000.00 every Bitfunded account starts at. The v3.12.0 import extended the journal back to inception (2026-06-21), so the baseline had been wrong for five weeks of real trading history. Corrected to 10,000.00

Data: backfilled fees on 41 of 59 rows for challenge 6 from the account's transaction log (Bitfunded's Position History, the v3.12.0 import's source, doesn't publish per-position fees). Matched on (challenge_id, pair, direction, time_in), not trade id. Funding fees (net 6.6369) are not attributable to a single trade and are applied once as challenges.funding_adjustment instead of split across rows. Fees now exceed trading losses on this account ($144.75 total cost vs $120.07 trading loss) — win rate falls from 39.0% to 33.9% net of fees, and net_pnl (not pnl) is the correct basis for any performance figure

Fix: challenges.current_balance dropped — it was a stored column nothing ever recalculated, which is what let the starting_balance error above go unnoticed for five weeks (the dashboard balance card read $9,108.98 against a real $9,735.18, and drawdown showed 0.0% against a real ~2.6%). Balance is now always derived (starting_balance + realised net P&L - funding_adjustment) via the new helpers.php::enrichChallenge(), applied everywhere a challenge row reaches a controller response: getActiveChallenge(), ChallengeController::getAll(), and both challenge fetches in ReviewEngineController. dashboard.js's sidebar balance also had an independent double-counting bug (account_balance + net_pnl, adding realised P&L a second time on top of an already-correct balance) — fixed to just display the derived value

Schema: added challenges.funding_adjustment, profit_target_amt, max_loss_amt for prop firms (Bitfunded included) that state challenge criteria as currency amounts per stage rather than percentages. profit_target_pct / max_drawdown_pct are kept, not replaced, but enrichChallenge() now overrides them with an amount-derived percentage whenever an amount is on file, so AlertController and ReviewEngineController::ruleDrawdownProximity() read the correct figure without their own amount-vs-percent branch

Schema: challenges converted from MyISAM/latin1 to InnoDB/utf8mb4 — the only table left on the old engine, and the reason trades.challenge_id never had a foreign key. FK added in a separate, deliberately-last migration with its own orphan-check guard, so an orphaned challenge_id on a given environment is reported rather than forced past or allowed to block the schema/data fixes ahead of it

Scope: challenge 6 (Bitfunded Altcoin) only. Challenges 4 (TradeFi) and 5 (BTC) have the same starting_balance and missing-fees defects and are not fixed here — the derivation/amount-preference code is shared and applies to them too, but no migration in this release writes to their rows
